# Directive 17

> We build companies that improve the human experience. The Future Should Make Life Better.

Directive 17 is an early-stage venture firm founded by Joel Shapiro. Every company begins with one question: how will this make someone's life better? Only then do we ask whether it can become a great business.

## Pages

- [Why We Exist](https://directive17.com/why.html): Most organizations begin with markets. We begin with people.
- [Philosophy](https://directive17.com/philosophy.html): The Five Pillars — happiness, health, trust, connection, human potential — and the Human Test.
- [Companies](https://directive17.com/companies.html): Portfolio companies. Different companies. One philosophy.
- [The Future We See](https://directive17.com/future.html): What future is worth building?
- [Build With Us](https://directive17.com/build.html): Contact — joel@directive17.com
- [A Note from the Founder](https://directive17.com/founders-note.html): Joel Shapiro on creating rather than consuming.

## Joel's Blog

- [My Life Philosophy May Be Terrible Advice](https://directive17.com/blog/my-life-philosophy.html): A list of sayings that felt less like inspirational wisdom and more like somebody had been secretly following me around for decades taking notes.
- [Apple, Psyllium & the Complete Collapse of Western Civilization](https://directive17.com/blog/apple-psyllium.html): I bought a MacBook. At almost exactly the same time, in an entirely unrelated act of spectacularly bad judgment, I added psyllium to my diet.
- [Black Plastic](https://directive17.com/blog/black-plastic.html): A meal-prep place with a beautiful sourcing story, a nutrition person, and a transparency pitch — serving everything in black plastic.
- [I Trust AI. I'm Starting Not to Trust the People Using It.](https://directive17.com/blog/i-trust-ai.html): Most people are worried about whether they can trust artificial intelligence. I have a different concern.
- [I Haven't Even Taken Off Yet](https://directive17.com/blog/i-havent-even-taken-off-yet.html): Another travel day. More craziness. And, as I write this, the airplane hasn't even left the gate.
- [There Are Some Things We Were Never Meant to Know](https://directive17.com/blog/some-things-we-were-never-meant-to-know.html): I would like to address one of the great architectural mistakes of our time: the unisex restaurant bathroom.
- [One Second. I'm Trying to Reach You.](https://directive17.com/blog/one-second-im-trying-to-reach-you.html): A true story about traffic, modern medicine, the Philippines, and humanity's relentless pursuit of efficiency.
- [We Have Run Out of Fish](https://directive17.com/blog/we-have-run-out-of-fish.html): One Quick Question — true stories from a world that makes less sense every day.
